mechanism: Ginkgo biloba may inhibit CYP3A4 and induce glucuronidation pathways, potentially reducing dolutegravir concentrations, while ginkgo's antiplatelet effects may increase bleeding risk in patients on antiretroviral therapy.
action: Monitor virologic response and consider dolutegravir level monitoring; counsel patients to avoid ginkgo biloba or use with caution, reporting any unusual bleeding or bruising.
